columns.name: JOB_APP_BID_INFO
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: SUBSCRIBER_ID
columns.description: To store the subscriber id. Foreign Key to IRC_TN_SUBSCRIBERS.

columns.name: JOB_APP_ID
columns.description: To store the job app id. Foreign Key to IRC_TN_JOB_APPLICATIONS.

columns.name: BID_RATE
columns.description: Stores the bid rate for this job application.

columns.name: BID_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Stores the currency code for the bid for this job application as a lookup code.

columns.name: PAY_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the pay frequency as a lookup code.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Stores comments about this job application bid information.

columns.name: REF_FA_SUBMISSION_ID
columns.description: Stores the reference submission id that is provided with this job application bid information.

columns.name: AGENCY_PROFILE_URL
columns.description: Stores the agency provided profile url of the candidate for this job application bid information.

columns.name: DISPLAY_RATE
columns.description: Stores the formatted rate information of this job application bid information.

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the status of the object.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
